findings.claim: The current Japanese entity explicitly styled SBIC East Japan is Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd., corporate number 9011001030621, established 1963-11-15.

SBIC East Japan is a private corporation and independent investor operating as a policy implementation institution under Japan's Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Company Act, Act No. 101 of 1963; it is not a government financial institution.

SBIC East Japan's official 2025 training curriculum included ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot; the June course was restricted to its investee companies. A separate February 2025 ChatGPT seminar was co-hosted with the Tokyo Chamber of Commerce and featured a Microsoft speaker.
The phrase 'ChatGPT SBIC' may be shorthand for SBIC East Japan's public AI/ChatGPT education events. The exact originating context has not been recovered, so this is not a confirmed interpretation.

SBI CAPITAL Co., Ltd. was a separate SBI Holdings fund-management entity. SBI Holdings' May 21, 2007 release records a 60% SBI Holdings / 40% Goldman Sachs-group affiliate ownership structure after the May 23 stock transfer.
No direct SBIC East Japan relationship with XRP, Ripple, Coinbase or Circle was established in the scoped official sources. This does not prove that no indirect portfolio-company relationship exists.
Two indexed YouTube videos are attributed to Kamilah Stevenson; the existing channel profile uses channel ID UCqUPJMQdkCN6lsLVDnichPA and remains a partial inventory.
The exact-name identity match between Camilla Stephenson and Kamilah Stevenson is not established. The requested all-public-video inventory remains incomplete.

competing_hypotheses.statement: 'ChatGPT SBIC' refers to ChatGPT training/seminars published by SBIC East Japan.
disconfirming: The original phrase context is unavailable; 'SBIC' has also been used for a separate historical SBI Capital entity.
competing_hypotheses.test: Recover the original surrounding phrase or source before treating this as the intended referent.

competing_hypotheses.statement: 'SBIC' refers to historical SBI CAPITAL Co., Ltd. within SBI Holdings.
disconfirming: This historical entity is not the Tokyo SBIC East Japan legal entity and the 2007 release does not mention ChatGPT or XRP.
competing_hypotheses.test: Require a contemporaneous SBI Capital source or original phrase context.
